articles.title: NASA's New Mars Helicopters Look Like Sci-Fi Come to Life!
articles.summary: NASA just showed off what its SkyFall helicopters will look like flying over Mars. Three choppers will scan for underground ice using special radar. They launch in 2028!

articles.title: This Tiny Microbe Turns Into a Giant Cannibal!
articles.summary: Scientists found a microbe called Euplotes gigatrox that sometimes grows huge and eats its own siblings. It was discovered in an aquarium filter in Curaçao. The change happens when there's lots of food.

articles.title: The World's Biggest Electric Plane Just Took Off!
articles.summary: A huge battery-powered plane called the X1 flew for the first time. It's as heavy as an empty school bus and can carry 30 people. The test flight used only $5 of electricity!
